INSERT INTO leave_balances (employee_id, leave_type_id, year, entitled_days, carried_forward)
                VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, GREATEST($5, 0::numeric))
                ON CONFLICT (employee_id, leave_type_id, year)
                DO UPDATE SET carried_forward = GREATEST($5, 0::numeric), updated_at = NOW()
